records.title: PhoenixOS: Concurrent OS-level GPU Checkpoint and Restore with Validated Speculation
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.12079. Primary abstract describes GPU process checkpoint/restore for fault tolerance, migration, and serverless cold starts; it is GPU infrastructure rather than an LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Tracing the Roots of Facts in Multilingual Language Models: Independent, Shared, and Transferred Knowledge
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.05189. Primary abstract analyzes multilingual BERT factual knowledge representation; it studies model behavior, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Roofline-Guided Mixed Quantization and Kernel Co-Optimization for Efficient Large Language Model Inference on Arm CPUs
records.reason: The primary abstract indicates an LLM-on-Arm inference optimization, but the primary full text was unavailable, so the system/evaluation and practical limits cannot be verified.

records.title: OPSDL: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Long-Context Language Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17535. Primary abstract proposes on-policy self-distillation to train long-context LLMs; its contribution is training quality/sample efficiency, not inference optimization.

records.title: On Data Engineering for Scaling LLM Terminal Capabilities
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21193. Primary abstract studies synthetic data and training for terminal agents; the measured gains are task performance from training.
